newsitem.title: USA: Zenith shares rise after FCC acts on HDTV.
newsitem.headline: Zenith shares rise after FCC acts on HDTV.

text.p: Shares of Zenith Electronics Corp rose on Friday, the day after the Federal Communications Commission voted to give U.S. broadcasters licenses to begin providing digital high definition television (HDTV).
"No one else has contributed as much to this technology," said Needham & Co analyst James Magid.
Zenith shares were up 7/8 at 11-1/8 in early afternoon trading.
Magid said Zenith stock was also helped by the company's securing $400 million in fresh financing this week.
The financing, backed by its majority holder LG Electronics Inc, ensures the electronics company's survival in a competitive industry, the analyst said.
